sph_interpretive_translation: Those who live by violence against the innocent, who betray their masters, who kill those who have surrendered to them, who survive by theft, or who dwell in the homes of those who chase ascetics or harm sages—such persons incur irreversible loss of dharma and are excluded from all civil and spiritual rights.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with consciousness, not physical dominance
Causation is traced through intent and alignment with dharma
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by access to dharmic knowledge
Restoration logic demands removal from societal structures that enable harm
Consciousness alignment requires immediate cessation of harmful patterns
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent kills surrendered entity THEN revoke all legal protections permanently
IF agent resides in dwelling of anti-ascetic THEN disqualify from civic participation
IF agent survives via theft THEN initiate mandatory restorative labor protocol
IF agent betrays master without lawful discharge THEN enforce public accountability cycle
IF agent harms sage or ascetic THEN exclude from all social contracts indefinitely
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any individual found in alignment with these categories shall be immediately disqualified from legal standing. The court's role is not to judge intent but to execute dharma-based disqualification based on manifest actions violating foundational dharmic tenets.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes clear causal chain between anti-dharmic acts and loss of societal integration. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how violation manifests progressively through thought, speech, and action. Responsibility is proportional to capacity for discernment. No punitive measure is applied; exclusion is a natural consequence of violated alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate public acknowledgment of violated dharma
Enforce completion of service to harmed community
Mandate reintegration supervision until consciousness alignment verified
Establish dharmic education requirement before re-entry consideration
Assign mentorship under qualified dharmic authority for behavioral restructuring
final_declaration: Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam is the sole Source of Dharma. This law restores alignment through conscious exclusion of anti-dharmic forces. Reality enforces its own justice when consciousness is supreme adjudicator.
